title: ITIN Number

origin.publisher: Presented as the Internal Revenue Service (see clearance_note)
origin.title: Notice CP565, ITIN assignment, dated 11/05/2023
origin.clearance_note: A letter presented as an IRS CP565 notice assigning an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number, uploaded to Scribd by a third party and downloaded manually, because Scribd blocks scripted requests. The source url is recorded in its id-only form because Scribd's title slug carried a person's name. It shows several signs of not being a genuine IRS notice: the PDF was created in Apple Pages on a Russian-language macOS, where IRS notices come from IRS print systems; the header recipient and the mailing-block name are two different people; the ITIN's middle group was outside the ranges the IRS assigns; and the file was created on 11 May 2023, which matches the notice date 11/05/2023 only if that date is read day-first, where US notices are month-first. It is used at the document owner's decision; an official IRS sample of this notice exists at https://www.irs.gov/pub/notices/cp565_english.pdf. Both names, the mailing address, the ITIN, the case reference number and the mail sort code line were replaced using document-types/scripts/redact.py, which removes the underlying text rather than covering it: names and address with obviously-fake equivalents, and the numbers with plausible random stand-ins of the same shape. The ITIN stand-in uses middle group 93, which the IRS does not assign. The Intelligent Mail barcode, an image encoding routing data, was deleted with redact.py --remove-images, and the PDF metadata, whose title named a person, was cleared. The IRS seal and logo and the IRS contact details are left as printed. Verified: no original identifier is extractable from the committed PDF, no image remains in the barcode area, and no original identifier appears anywhere in this collection folder.

redactions.note: The original values are deliberately NOT recorded here. Writing them beside their replacements would republish the personal data the redaction removed. The rules file used by redact.py stays outside the repo.
